text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Narita Brian's poor health persists, Hishi Amazon believes in her—and doubles down on her own training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian suffers a crushing defeat at the autumn Tenno Sho. The audience is aghast by how weak she is now, and their expectations begin to fade…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But during an interview before the Japan Cup, Hishi Amazon declares to everyone that her rival is Narita Brian, and Narita Brian alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's adamant that her rival will make a comeback. The conviction rubs off on the public, restoring some of their faith.
